item.content:encoded:
I enjoyed the iterating details/conversations throughout and some of the visuals were very good, but the final choice didn't really make things any clearer or provide any sense of resolution. I can definitely understand that as a storytelling choice, but the current content wasn't enough for me to be satisfied with that.

The connection with 055 or setting 055 as the ending was pretty tenuous for me. After reading the comments I went back to check white text (I don't get to the lines), but I definitely feel like if I was missing something, it wasn't located there.

No vote

– hide block

the ending just loops round to the start rather than resolving in the way that the progressive, recursive changes suggest it might,

but then if you're going for the Rule Of Spook / the more horrific of the potential outcomes, it certainly qualifies. And I assume there's been some kind of weird memetic-timeloop-realitywarp containment breach that
+ show block
– hide block

SCP-055 is trying to save everybody from, after coming across an incident in progress at the party, but all it can do is make them forget and thereby somehow rewind their personal clock to a few

minutes before their death, Groundhog Day style, just with fewer retained memories and less spare time so they can't actually do anything about it. Maybe it's even doing it to each team member in turn and we're only getting to see one perspective. Seems like everyone else except maybe Melina has it worse though.Engaging read, though, even if
+ show block
– hide block

it ultimately didn't lead anywhere.
